headline: Garlic Prices Rise in 248 Regions, Bapanas Asks Local Governments to Improve Supervision Accuracy
summary: The number of Indonesian regencies and cities recording garlic price increases in July reached 248, prompting Bapanas to ask local governments to tighten supervision.
why: Food prices feed into household inflation, and Bapanas is Indonesia's national food agency responsible for staple price stability.
